text: Marla City today: Reed's peach pie offer gets shut down again, this time by Dusk and Flint, who say Mrs. Elara needs bug spray for her aphid problem, not baked goods, while Lumen's "let's all check the garden together" plan is still just talk. The drainage pipe in Sector Gamma is already fixed, but Flint's mad that it took three workers pulled off other jobs to do it, so he's marching Vale out there at 1800 hours sharp to figure out who dropped the ball. Dusk is back at the docks giving the same speech about ignoring warning signs, translating a busted pipe into a life lesson instead of actually fixing anything himself.
